title: Prince Zanithor 1.0.0
author: Zanithor
description:
For long time, you had to track and hunt down concubines and minions on your own around the world. Not anymore.

The Dark Prince offers you Prince Zanithor, the Hunter, his warband and his trusted mage, to help you track down the Queens and Ladies of this world.

This mod adds a dilema at turn 2 for Prince Zanithor: a Demon Prince of Slaanesh, whose warband and trusted mage can help you track and capture your victims around the world.

He comes with special traits and abilities to help you in your quest with the best way possible

(I don't care if it is balanced )

For now, the only supported option is Southlands, near Khalida, to support the Khalida's corruption questline.

As new questlines are added, expect the options to expand.

This mod is compatible with Azazel, N'kari and SHOULD be compatible with Bel'akor, Archaon, Sigvald.
